name: CurrencyRate.Today – Currency Blocks and Widgets
author: falselight

sections.description:
⚠️ Pre-release (0.x.x) — This plugin is in active development. The first stable release (1.0) is coming later this month. Until then, settings format, shortcode attributes, block markup, and PHP/JS APIs may change between updates without a deprecation period. Please keep backups before updating.

Full standalone wordpress plugin — no iframes, no external embeds, no dependency on third-party website scripts with PRO features.

Show live exchange rates and let visitors convert 173 currencies directly on your website. Whether you run a travel site, exchange service, financial platform, or international store, the plugin helps users understand prices faster and compare values with less friction.

It includes 5 Gutenberg blocks and matching shortcodes, supports multiple providers on the same site, lets you assign a different source to each block, and can also work with your own custom rates. It is designed for real website use cases — from exchange tables and converters to featured exchange rate cards, localized price badges, and live tickers.

5 Blocks Included

📊 Exchange Rates

Compare multiple currencies at once. A rate table for a single base currency with 24-hour change, flag icons, and optional CTA buttons — the core block for finance pages, exchange offices, and travel sites.

💱 Currency Converter

Let visitors convert prices instantly. An interactive widget where users pick two currencies and see the result immediately — with flags, compact layout, and JSON-LD structured data for SEO.

📈 Exchange Rate Card

Highlight one important pair. A compact card with the current rate, daily change, and an optional sparkline chart — ideal for sidebars, footers, or anywhere you want to draw attention to a specific pair.

🏷 Price Badge

Localize fixed prices for international visitors. A collapsible badge that shows how much a set amount costs in one or more target currencies — perfect for product pages, pricing tables, and global catalogs.

📢 Exchange Rates Ticker

Keep live market context visible site-wide. A scrolling marquee with multiple pairs, live rates, and 24-hour change — configurable speed, direction, pause-on-hover, and separator style for headers and footers.

Why Site Owners Choose It

  • Works with multiple exchange-rate sources — assign a different provider to each block
  • Covers different placement needs with rate tables, converters, price badges, featured pairs, and live tickers
  • Supports both Gutenberg blocks and shortcodes
  • Lets you use custom rates for exchange services or internal pricing
  • Built for real website use cases, not just basic demos

Features

Visitor experience

  • 💱 Convert 173 currencies instantly
  • 📊 Show live rates and 24-hour changes
  • 📈 Highlight key pairs with cards, badges, or a scrolling ticker

Site flexibility

  • 🧩 5 Gutenberg blocks with matching shortcodes
  • 🌍 Assign a different source to each block independently
  • 🔀 Run multiple providers on the same site
  • 💼 Use your own custom rates for exchange services or internal pricing

Presentation and SEO

  • 📦 Adapt widgets to different layouts or keep them compact where space matters
  • 🚩 Display flag icons and optional sparkline charts where they improve clarity
  • 🎨 Adjust the visual style with accent stripes, color borders, and gradient presets
  • 🎯 Add custom CTA buttons linking to exchange pages or related actions
  • 🔎 Help search engines understand pricing with ExchangeRateSpecification JSON-LD

Perfect For

  • ✈️ Travel and booking websites showing prices for international visitors
  • 💱 Currency exchange services and remittance platforms
  • 🏦 Banks and financial portals
  • 🛒 E-commerce stores with global audiences
  • 🌐 Business websites that publish international pricing
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin to /wp-content/plugins/currencyrate-today-currency-blocks or install it through the Plugins screen in WordPress.
  2. Activate the plugin.
  3. Open the plugin settings page and configure your sources, refresh interval, and display options.
  4. Add any of the five blocks in Gutenberg, or use the built-in shortcode generator.
sections.faq:
Do I need an API key?

No. The built-in proxy works out of the box with no API key or account.

Does it support Gutenberg?

Yes. All five blocks — Exchange Rates, Currency Converter, Exchange Rate Card, Price Badge, and Exchange Rates Ticker — are native Gutenberg blocks.

Can I use shortcodes?

Yes. Every block has a matching shortcode. The settings page includes a shortcode generator for all five blocks.

Which built-in sources are available?

The plugin ships with 15 built-in central-bank and market sources. You can also add your own custom rates.

  • 🌍 CurrencyRate (USD) — 173 currencies, mid-market rates
  • 🇺🇦 PrivatBank (UAH) — cash and transfer deals
  • 🇪🇺 ECB (EUR) — ~30 currencies, European Central Bank reference rates
  • 🇦🇺 RBA (AUD) — Reserve Bank of Australia reference rates
  • 🇺🇦 NBU (UAH) — National Bank of Ukraine reference rates
  • 🇦🇷 Dolar Blue (ARS) — Argentine parallel-market rates
  • 🇦🇷 BCRA (ARS) — Banco Central de la República Argentina reference rates
  • 🇳🇬 CBN (NGN) — Central Bank of Nigeria reference rates
  • 🇧🇷 BCB (BRL) — Banco Central do Brasil reference rates
  • 🇨🇿 CNB (CZK) — Czech National Bank reference rates
  • 🇵🇱 NBP (PLN) — National Bank of Poland reference rates
  • 🇷🇴 NBR (RON) — National Bank of Romania reference rates
  • 🇬🇧 BoE (GBP) — Bank of England reference rates
  • 🇮🇱 BoI (ILS) — Bank of Israel reference rates
  • 🇹🇭 BoT (THB) — Bank of Thailand reference rates
  • ✏️ Custom rates — define your own rates for any currency pair

Can I use different sources for different blocks?

Yes. Each block or shortcode can use its own configured source.

Can I use my own exchange rates?

Yes. You can configure custom rates for exchange services, banks, or internal pricing.

How often is the data updated?

The plugin refresh interval is configurable, with a minimum of 15 minutes. The upstream proxy refreshes its cache regularly, typically about every 5 minutes.

Who maintains this plugin?

CurrencyRate.Today has been building currency tools since 2014 and maintains multiple free plugins in the WordPress directory. Support typically responds within 24 hours.

Does this plugin connect to external services?

Yes. The plugin retrieves exchange-rate data from remote providers when a source is configured.

Does it track users or include analytics?

No. The plugin does not include analytics or visitor tracking.

Which external services may be used?

This plugin can connect to remote exchange-rate services when a site owner enables and configures a source that uses external data.

Supported services may include:

CRToday Currency Proxy: https://crtoday.fex.to/

CurrencyRate.Today: https://currencyrate.today/

When are requests sent to external services?

Requests may be made:

when a block or shortcode is rendered and the plugin cache is missing or expired;

when a manual refresh is triggered in the plugin settings.

What data is exchanged with external services?

When refreshing its cache, the plugin makes standard HTTP GET requests to public JSON endpoints, sending parameters like the active source and requested currencies. The site receives a JSON snapshot with exchange rates and timestamps. The plugin does not track visitors or send any personal data. As with any web request, your site’s server IP address is visible to the requested proxy.

For the default CRToday Currency Proxy, you can review its Terms of Service (https://crtoday.fex.to/terms.html) and Data Disclaimer (https://crtoday.fex.to/disclaimer.html).

Is the full source code included?

Yes. The full uncompressed source code is bundled with the plugin. Build files in build/ are compiled from TypeScript sources in src/ using @wordpress/scripts. Run npm install && npm run build to rebuild.
sections.changelog:
0.10.0

  • Added 12 new built-in central bank sources: ECB (EUCB), RBA, NBU, Dolar Blue, BCRA, CBN, BCB, CNB, NBP, NBR, BoE, BoI
  • WP-Cron background fetch — exchange rates refresh automatically without blocking page loads
  • Source selection limited to 3 active sources (MAX_SOURCES = 3)
  • Sub-tab navigation for Sources (Built-in / Local) and Storage (Database / Cache) settings
  • Renamed ECB source identifier to EUCB for consistency
  • Emoji flags next to source labels in admin UI
  • Renamed internal “DEFAULT” deal type to “STANDARD” across the codebase
  • Shortcode generator updated for all five blocks

0.9.1

  • TBD

0.9.0

  • Added 3 new blocks: Exchange Rate Card, Price Badge, and Exchange Rates Ticker
  • Exchange Rate Card — single currency pair with current rate, 24-hour change, and optional sparkline chart
  • Price Badge — collapsible badge converting a fixed amount into multiple target currencies
  • Exchange Rates Ticker — horizontally scrolling marquee with multiple currency pairs, configurable speed, direction, and separators
  • Accent stripes and color-border styling with gradient theme presets for all card-style blocks
  • Compact mode and source label support across all blocks
  • Built-in shortcode generator now covers all five blocks
  • Unified default handling: shortcode generator produces clean shortcodes with no redundant attributes
  • Improved internal code consistency and reduced code duplication

0.2.0

  • Minor bug fixes in Currency Converter behavior
  • Improved keyboard focus handling in converter currency dropdown search
  • Small visual polish update for converter fields and currency selector button

0.1.1

  • Shortcode generator fixes and UI improvements

0.1.0

  • Initial public release
  • Exchange Rates and Currency Converter Gutenberg blocks
  • Shortcode support and built-in shortcode generator
  • Multiple source support
  • Custom rate support
  • Optional CTA buttons
  • ExchangeRateSpecification JSON-LD output
